description: This file contains unit tests for reftable read/write operations, including buffer handling, table writing, reading, seeking, and error handling, within a version control system context.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__buffer
methods.description: Tests buffer addition and data reading from a reftable buffer source.

methods.name: write_table
methods.description: Creates a table with specified number of references and logs, writing to a buffer.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__log_buffer_size
methods.description: Tests buffer extension and compression during log writing.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__log_overflow
methods.description: Tests handling of log record overflow errors.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__log_write_limits
methods.description: Tests limits enforcement during log writing.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__log_write_read
methods.description: Tests writing and reading back logs and references, including iteration and seeking.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__log_zlib_corruption
methods.description: Tests error handling when log data is corrupted.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_write_sequential
methods.description: Tests sequential reading of a large table.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__table_write_small_table
methods.description: Tests writing a small table and checks size.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_api
methods.description: Tests table API for reading references and logs.

methods.name: t_table_read_write_seek
methods.description: Tests seeking within a table at a specific index and hash type.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_write_seek_linear
methods.description: Tests linear seek in table with SHA1 hash.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_write_seek_linear_sha256
methods.description: Tests linear seek in table with SHA256 hash.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_write_seek_index
methods.description: Tests index seek in table with SHA1 hash.

methods.name: reftable_refs_for
methods.description: Creates references, writes them, and tests retrieval of references for a table, with optional indexing.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__table_refs_for_no_index
methods.description: Tests reference retrieval without index.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__table_refs_for_obj_index
methods.description: Tests reference retrieval with object index.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__write_empty_table
methods.description: Tests behavior when writing an empty table.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__write_object_id_min_length
methods.description: Tests object ID length when hashes are identical.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__write_object_id_length
methods.description: Tests object ID length when hashes vary.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__write_empty_key
methods.description: Tests behavior when writing a reference with an empty key.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__write_key_order
methods.description: Tests ordering constraints when writing references.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__write_multiple_indices
methods.description: Tests writing multiple references and logs with indices.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__write_multi_level_index
methods.description: Tests creation of multi-level index in table.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__corrupt_table_empty
methods.description: Tests error handling for empty table corruption.

methods.name: test_reftable_readwrite__corrupt_table
methods.description: Tests error handling for table corruption.
